snippet.title: Indie Devlog - Super Cat Tales Tower Game & More!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Dino Quake: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3342430/Dino_Quake/
Play Bufo Merge on Poki: https://poki.com/en/g/bufo-merge
Play Bufo Merge on Mobile: https://www.neutronized.com/BufoMerge/download.php

Join my Discord: https://discord.com/invite/supercattales

In this devlog, I’m sharing updates on multiple projects I’ve been working on:

I just launched Bufo Merge, a quick and fun merge minigame where you combine frogs to fight off waves of enemies. It features a new art style inspired by Yoshi's Island and some fun wiggly animations. Available now on mobile and Poki! 🐸

I also got back to my Super Cat Tales Tower 3D game, starring Alex! After reviving the project and fixing some Unity issues, I added a jump button to improve controls and accessibility. More levels and a Steam page are on the way! 🐱

Dino Quake is part of Steam Next Fest starting next week! There's a free demo available now, so check it out and wishlist the game on Steam! 🦖

Feel free to join my Discord to chat, ask questions, or just hang out — I’m usually online! Thanks for watching and stay tuned for more updates! 🙌
